operations.text: 0.2.1 is a code-only release: the defects that kept the Linux and macOS CI legs red are fixed, the six CLI entrypoints now recognise themselves when the payload sits behind a symlinked directory (a POSIX temp dir is one), and the self-check's provenance scan no longer reads the harness's own plugin-cache markers as payload files. All of it is payload code - this migration touches nothing in your project: no config key, no managed region, no agent file. There is nothing for you to do; the CHANGELOG entry is the whole story
